messages.subject: javascript condiitonal for conditional panel
parts:
I am trying to use a conditional panel as a 'shiny busy' message panel to users of my app.  I have been using the below in my ui.R to create such a panel and display a .gif
when my app is busy calculating a plot:

          tabPanel("Plot",  
              plotOutput(outputId = "plot"),  
              
              conditionalPanel(
                  condition="$('div#plot').hasClass('recalculating') ",
                  img(src="dogfetcher2.gif"), h5("fetching data; please wait...")
              ),
              
             conditionalPanel(
                 condition="!($('div#plot').hasClass('recalculating')", br()
              ),
         ),

This works fine, except the for the first time after app launch that one is waiting for a plot is to be calculated/displayed.  The .gif does not show the first time. 
I thought the below might fix that problem, as a guess, since I do not know JavaScript:

         condition="$('div#plot').hasClass('recalculating') || $('div#plot') == NULL "

The result of that conditional is for the conditional panel gif to always be displayed!  Not the preferred behavior.  Can anyone suggest how to correct the conditional statement to get the desired result?

Please spare me any flames.  Thanks.
